BiblicalUsage: Riʼshônîy carries the sense of first. It stands in Jeremiah 25:1: "…fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah…".
TheologicalSignificance: I hold riʼshônîy as God's own word, even if it appears only here.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
